body:
#  Admin Commands Plugin

AdminCommands is a lightweight, Folia-compatible admin utility plugin that adds 11 essential OP-only commands for moderation and server management. It is designed to be simple, fast, and fully configurable.

## Features
11 new admin commands (OP-only)
Folia-ready (safe usage of Folia schedulers where needed)
Fully configurable messages via config.yml (prefix + all command messages)
Helpful moderation utilities: vanish, freeze, godmode, inventory lock, chat tools, and basic player history

## Commands
**/vanish (alias: /v) — toggle vanish**

**/freeze <player> — freeze a player**

**/unfreeze <player> — unfreeze a player**

**/god [player] — toggle godmode for yourself or another player**

**/heal [player] — heal yourself or another player**

**/feed [player] — feed yourself or another player**

**/fly — toggle flight**

**/speed <1-10> — set walk/fly speed (depending on whether you are flying)**

**/seen <player> — shows a player’s current world and coordinates**

**/clearchat — clears the chat for everyone**

**/invlock — toggles inventory lock for yourself (blocks inventory actions, item pickup/drop, 
block placing, and consuming items)**

**/history <player> — shows recent block breaks + last kill (simple history)**

## Permissions
No permission nodes needed
All commands are OP-only (/op required)
You can use luckperms

## Configuration
Customize all messages and the prefix in:
plugins/AdminCommands/config.yml

## Compatibility
Built for Folia (and works on modern Paper builds that support Paper plugins)
Works on Minecraft 1.21.x (depending on your server build)
